claims: "GM" most commonly refers to General Motors Company
General Motors Company is an American multinational automotive manufacturer
General Motors Company is headquartered in Detroit, Michigan
General Motors Company brands include Chevrolet, Buick, GMC, and Cadillac
General Motors Company is publicly traded on the NYSE with ticker GM
General Motors produces trucks, crossovers, cars, and electric vehicles (EVs) with charging technology
Mary Barra is Chair and CEO of General Motors
General Motors is the largest automaker in the U.S. for multiple years
General Motors was founded in 1908 by William C. Durant
General Motors operates numerous facilities globally
General Motors parts brands include GM Genuine Parts and ACDelco
General Manager (GM) is a high-level business or sports executive responsible for operations
"gm" commonly means Good Morning on social media/chat
